title: Distribution of Sandpile groups of random bipartite graphs
summary: Fix a prime $p$ and a constant $\frac{1}{p}<α\leq 1$. Consider the random Erdős--Rényi bipartite graph $G_α(n,u)$ with bipartition $(V_1,V_2)$ of sizes $|V_1|=n$ and $|V_2|=\lceilαn\rceil$, and edge probability $0<u<1$. The authors of [1] and [8] conjectured a limiting distribution for the $p$-Sylow subgroup of the sandpile group of $G_α(n,u)$ as $n\to\infty$. We prove this conjecture for odd primes $p$.
